_comment: Mutation testing scoped to the pure updated-invariant policy core. Each mutant is applied to src/card-write-guard.ts, compiled by a single-file tsc into lib/src/card-write-guard.js (what the test imports), then the scoped mocha suite runs. A surviving mutant means the tests do NOT constrain that line — a real gap. Run under Node 20 (.nvmrc): `nvm use 20.20.0 && npm run test:mutation`.
